Toddler meals

Apple porridge

Almás zabkása

6 months+ Sound idea 15 min 2 portions

Cow's milk in the porridge is fine; it is not a drink. Use water only when you need a milk-free bowl.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 40 g Rolled oats (Ordinary or fine)
  • 1 small Eating apple (Peeled, cored, and grated)
  • 200 ml Full-fat milk (Pasteurized; use the same amount of water for a milk-free pot)

Allergens

glutenmilk

Method

  1. Put the oats, grated apple, and milk or water in a small pan.
  2. Bring to a simmer and stir.
  3. Cook until the oats and apple are soft, adding a splash of water if it thickens too much.
  4. Cool to serving temperature and mash any firmer bits.
  5. Serve as a bowl, not a drink.

Sound idea

Added sugar is unnecessary because the apple is already sweet. A milk-free eater still needs a water-only pot.

Cook the oats in water or full-fat milk with grated apple, and add no sugar. Offer the water-only pot as the milk-free step.
